content: Advance M0110/W0112 on the CUDA critical path by making the CPU backend's versioned C ABI execute pre-serialized Kernel IR modules through synchronous Add/Copy-compatible submit calls. Define a bounded CPU argument-block encoding over backend memory handles, implement module load/unload and submit with strict dimensions, ranges, ownership, and status mapping, and prove it in ABI tests. Keep cdev descriptor-to-argument resolution, registered-memory DMA mapping, daemon replacement, and kernel fault qualification open.

Keep the cdev worker backend-agnostic: extend the CPU backend C ABI first, using private fixed-width argument bytes over backend memory handles. load_module owns a canonical KIR copy; submit remains synchronous, 2D, and without completion events. CUDA/PTX parsing stays in compatibility/daemon code, while cdev descriptor-to-argument resolution remains the next W0112 slice.

Content revision b7dbabf adds MF_BACKEND_CAP_LAUNCH, CPU module load/unload and strict synchronous submit, and the canonical Add PTX backend regression. nix develop . --command cmake --build --preset dev --parallel 2 passed; focused backend/cdev tests 3/3 and full dev CTest 84/84 passed; clang-format and git diff --check passed.

Content revision 6f047f4 adds generation-bound cdev launch descriptor helpers, CdevLaunchResolver payload-range and 2D validation, synchronous backend submit dispatch, and a real CPU canonical-KIR Add loop through the cdev worker. Focused cdev/CPU tests passed 4/4 and full development CTest passed 84/84; clang-format and git diff --check passed.

Content revision fcdcbbd requires a synchronous backend-operation lease for every bound cdev COPY or LAUNCH. The worker holds the lease across resolver access and the backend ABI call, surfaces lease rejection without local fallback, and releases it after the synchronous call returns. The cdev worker regression covers successful, timeout, resolver-failure, and lease-rejection paths; full development CTest passed 84/84, clang-format and git diff --check passed, and agent records remained valid.

Content revision 7bdcedf adds a backend-agnostic CdevCopyResolver for MF_RING_COPY_FLAG_REGION_ARGUMENT_BLOCK_V1. The resolver maps argument-block object references to independent destination/source backend memory handles and ranges; the worker validates handles, overflow, and reserved fields, holds the synchronous lease across resolution and mf_backend_api_v1.copy, and maps resolver/backend status. Region success and stale resolver regressions passed; full development CTest passed 84/84, build/format/diff checks passed. Registered-memory DMA, asynchronous ownership, generation replacement, and physical-device qualification remain open.

Content revision 301c379 aligns cdev region COPY with the shared descriptor identity contract: target_id is the argument-block object ID, arguments[0] is its generation, and arguments[1..3] are reserved zero. The worker applies queue-generation validation to legacy COPY/LAUNCH but delegates region object-generation freshness to CdevCopyResolver; cdev client descriptor/submit helpers encode the same form. Descriptor, non-queue target, and malformed reserved-field regressions passed; full development CTest passed 84/84. Registered-memory DMA, asynchronous ownership, generation replacement, and physical-device qualification remain open.
